name: Minutes of Meeting
one_liner: What was discussed, who was actually there, what was decided and who does what by when — then copied into the logs.
purpose: Minutes of Meeting (MoM) provide a summary of what was discussed in a meeting, including project issues, decisions taken and risks identified, and can be used as an input into subsequent meetings. The guide requires the MoM to be distributed to the stakeholders identified for that meeting and to include a summary of project issues raised, risks identified, decisions taken and changes proposed — and states explicitly that those issues, risks, decisions and project changes must also be recorded in the relevant logs.
created_in: Any phase — after every project meeting
approved_by: Not approved — issued by the designated minute-taker and distributed to the meeting's distribution list
inputs: The meeting itself and the minute-taker's notes
feeds: Project Handbook (from the Planning Kick-off MoM)
gate: None — but the Planning Kick-off MoM is a named input to the Project Handbook

fields.what: When the minutes were issued. Minutes are distributed promptly after the meeting; late minutes are a quality finding in the Quality Review Checklist.

fields.what: Everyone on the attendee list, with the initials used in the decision and action tables so ownership is unambiguous.
fields.who: Minute-taker fills from the agenda's invitee list
fields.castor: ÉM, RT, KB, PM, AF (Marie Curie, UR), IS (Albert Einstein, AO), BI (Gustave Eiffel, CPM).

fields.what: Whether each listed attendee was actually there. This column is the difference between the agenda's invitation list and a record of who is bound by the decisions.
fields.castor: W. Edwards Deming (PQA) absent, represented by Henry Gantt (PSO); all PSC members present.

fields.what: A summary of the meeting agenda — objectives and agenda items — so the minutes stand alone without the agenda document attached.
fields.castor: Debriefing, problems and actions, status against scope/budget/finish date, formal approvals, AOB.

fields.what: Points discussed and outcomes. Must summarise project issues raised, risks identified, decisions taken and changes proposed — the four things the guide names explicitly.
fields.castor: Verbal request from a Board of Directors member's cabinet to add SRF-backstop screens to Release 1.

fields.what: A stable identifier per decision so it can be cross-referenced from the Decision Log, from issues and from change records.
fields.who: Minute-taker allocates · PM maintains the Decision Log
fields.castor: D-014 and D-015, both carried into the CASTOR Decision Log on 16 Oct 2026.

fields.what: What was decided, in enough detail to be actionable and auditable later; escalated decisions state which body took them.
fields.castor: Request not to be actioned verbally; PM to raise a Change Request; Release 1 scope unchanged pending assessment.

fields.f: Decisions taken — Date of Decision Taken / Decision Owner
fields.what: When the decision was made and who owns it. The owner is recorded by initials and is accountable for the decision holding.
fields.castor: 15/10/26 · ÉM — Florence Nightingale owns both decisions as chair of the PSC.

fields.f: Actions / ToDo Items — Action Id, Creation Date, Description
fields.what: Each action with its identifier, creation date and what must be done. Significant actions are also added to the Project Work Plan, not just to the minutes.
fields.castor: A-031: raise Change Request CR-011 in the Change Log with status Submitted, created 15/10/26.

fields.what: Open, In Progress, Closed or On Hold. The status list is fixed by the template, and open items are carried forward into the next meeting's minutes.
fields.castor: A-031, A-032 and A-033 all Open at issue; A-031 closed on 21 Oct 2026 when CR-011 was logged.

fields.f: Actions / ToDo Items — Target Resolution Date / Owner
fields.what: Deadline and owner initials. Late items must be followed up — the Quality Review Checklist asks whether follow-up on late items happens at all.
fields.castor: A-032 impact assessment by Nikola Tesla, due 05/11/26; A-033 legal check by KB, due 29/10/26.

fields.f: Proposed Agenda for Next Meeting / Proposed Next Meeting Date
fields.what: Potential agenda items and the date of the next meeting, making the MoM an input into the following meeting rather than a dead record.
fields.castor: 19 Nov 2026 — CR-011 impact assessment and PSC decision on the SRF-backstop screens.

fields.what: Documents referenced during the meeting and where they are stored, so readers of the minutes can reach the evidence.
fields.castor: Change Log, Decision Log and Risk Log in 04 Monitor & Control of the CASTOR repository.

traps: MoM items — issues, risks, decisions, changes — must also be recorded in the relevant logs.
The MoM is a summary, not a register; the Decision Log and Change Log are the registers.
PSC minutes are taken by the BM, not the PM; the PO chairs.
A verbal scope request becomes a Change Request, a Change Log entry and a PSC decision — never a favour.
The Planning Kick-off MoM is a named input to the Project Handbook, not just a courtesy record.
